summary: Collector road kerb with almost no parked cars and houses 10-13 m away.
reasons: Through road, hardly any cars parked
Houses 10-13 m away on both sides
Steep for most of its length

best_section.where: Jerrang Street, north kerb, at the downhill end near the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 11-19 m from the kerb here and face it; neighbours would notice a van overnight.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with painted lane markings; only a few kerbside cars, no verge or pull-in.
drivers.traffic: Through road linking a roundabout and a junction, with moving traffic in both images.
drivers.convention: Only one or two cars parked on this side, so no clear parking convention.

flags: Steep: 7.5% average, 17.6% max over the whole stretch
Houses 10-13 m away along most of it
sun_shade: Mostly open, with street trees giving patchy shade from the south side; morning sun from the east.
